template_data.lead_html: Three years of waiting. One decision that changed everything.

rows.what_html: Watching from the sidelines — waiting for past performance that never came on its own
GSA Schedule application — the credential that finally opens the federal door
First federal award — and the realization the Schedule was always the starting block, not the finish line

template_data.closer: THE SCHEDULE IS HOW YOU BUILD PAST PERFORMANCE.
